The Roman Empire

Regarding the data breach described, the impact is significant despite the absence of financial data. The compromise of private messages and user IP addresses directly threatens user anonymity, which is a core feature of the forum. This exposure can lead to doxxing, harassment, or retaliation against users who relied on anonymity for privacy or free speech. Consequently, the breach undermines trust in the platform's ability to protect user identity and may have chilling effects on open discourse.
